description: Cron Expression Converter — Convert a schedule between unix cron, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes CronJob, Quartz, AWS EventBridge cron(...) and systemd OnCalendar. Auto-detects the input format (5-field unix, 6/7-field Quartz, AWS cron(...), @daily-style macros), fixes day-of-week numbering (unix 0=Sun vs Quartz/AWS 1=Sun), adds the required ? field, and splits unix either-day-of-month-or-week schedules into two triggers where the target cannot express them. Returns expanded fields plus per-target notes (UTC, time zones, 5-minute GitHub minimum). Params: expr=, optional from=auto|unix|quartz|aws. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_cron_convert
